Start with a measurable pilot

Agree what success means before installation.

01Assess02Plan03Document
01

Choose a representative area

Pick a location with known usage patterns and a team able to keep records. An unusually quiet washroom may not represent the rest of a busy building.

02

Record before and after

Keep a baseline for usage assumptions, maintenance work and complaints. After installation, record consumable changes, service time and observations using the same definitions.

03

Decide with evidence

Review the agreed observation period with facilities and cleaning teams. Separate measured results from estimates and document any changes in occupancy before extending the project.
